pairs.l: 1  Caution. Contains hazardous or toxic material. Handle with care at all times.
2  He is not like you, he is different. He has his own problems, just like everybody. Help him out.
3  If you can’t get it to work the way you’re doing it, don’t give up. Go about it another way.
4  Thanks for the invite. I’d love to visit you this weekend but it’s just impossible. Wait until I’m less busy.
5  Be careful of dating Dave. He has a dangerous reputation and easily loses his temper. I hope you can deal with him.

r1.exp: 1→C (opasno = It’s dangerous), 2→E (pomoži mu = Be caring), 3→B (pokušaj drugačije = Try something different), 4→F (drugi put = Another time), 5→D (težak je za nositi se s njim). A suvišan.

r6.exp: “You know my aunt’s house in the mountains? It would be nice to go there, for a change.” → tetkin dom. Sestra ju ometa, ali Luisa želi tečetkin dom.

r7.exp: “Just don’t forget your Cuban jazz CD.” → glazbu (some music). Piće ima, hranu si mora donijeti sam ako želi.

r8.exp: “He didn’t even open it.” → Peter je ignorirao dar. Knjiga je bila skupa i Susan je potrošila puno vremena, ali razloč razočaranja je to što je Petar nije ni otvorio.

r9.exp: “I’ve got some video games. Bring your favourites. We can try them out.” → Riley želi igrati igrice s Tedom.

r10.exp: “Email me so I know what’s happening with you.” → Anne želi da joj Lara piše (write to her).

r11.exp: “I am working in a communications agency as a secretary.” → posao = tajnica/secretary.

r12.exp: “She has a degree in it [nutrition].” → diplomirala je prehrambenu scijenc. Prihvatljivo: Nutrition / nutrition.

r13.exp: “At sixty, maybe I’m a bit overweight now.” → trenutna težina = 60 kg. Prihvatljivo: sixty / 60.

r14.exp: “if I have any time left over I read” → hobi = čitanje (reading).

r15.exp: “nothing can beat a pizza” → omiljena hrana = pizza.

pairs.l: 16  This is your first and best sign ___
pairs.r: C — that you’re dealing with a liar

pairs.l: 17  Liars blink less frequently, as if they need to keep their eyes open and on you ___
pairs.r: B — to make sure you believe their tale

pairs.l: 18  They touch their face and mouth a lot, and most liars can’t control it ___
pairs.r: A — even if they are aware they’re doing it
D — even when they aren’t actually accused

pairs.l: 20  Take a closer look at their body language to get the idea of ___
pairs.r: F — what’s going on in a person’s subconscious

r16.exp: 16→C (znak da lažeš), 17→B (da bi te uvjerili), 18→A (ne mogu kontrolirati ni kad su svjesni), 19→D (braniti se i kad nisu optuženi), 20→F (govor tijela otkriva podsvijest). E suvišan.

r21.exp: “In this way” = na ovaj način. Fiksna fraza.

r22.exp: “They are not bored” = nisu dosadni (osjećaj). ‘Bored’ opisuje kako se osoba osjeća. ‘Boring’ bi opisivalo aktivnost.

r23.exp: “As a teaching tool” = kao nastavno pomagalo. ‘As’ za ulogu/funkciju.

r24.exp: “Due to” = zbog, uslijed. Fiksna prepozicijska fraza: ‘due to + uzrok’.

r25.exp: Present perfect: “has become old-fashioned” = postalo je zastarjelo (relevantno za sadašnjost).

r26.exp: “In the centre of Manhattan” = u središtu Manhattana. Fiksna prepozicija ‘of’ uz ‘centre’.

r27.exp: “More than a hundred thousand” = više od sto tisuća. Komparativ + ‘than’.

r28.exp: Bezlična rečenica s formalnim subjektom: “it took 15 years” = trebalo je 15 godina.

r29.exp: “At once” = odmah, istog trena. Fiksna fraza.

r30.exp: Relativna rečenica za mjesto: “a place where people could meet” = mjesto gdje su se mogli sastati.

sol.ans: Referentni odgovor mora: (1) navesti kamo je učenik išao na izlet i zašto, (2) opisati što su radili, (3) opisati najljepši dio. 50–70 riječi, neformalan ton.

pairs.r: E — I can’t manage without you.

l1.exp: 1→F (nastavi), 2→A (možda ću doći), 3→E (ne mogu bez tebe), 4→B (nađimo se), 5→C (pusti to). D suvišan.

l6.exp: Muškarac u recepciji recept. Prezime = Purvise.

l7.exp: Muškarac obično jede sendvič za ručak (a sandwich).

l8.exp: Djevojčica će kupiti dječakov ulaznicu (the girl).

l9.exp: Sam se osjeća pripremljeno za prezentaciju (prepared).

l10.exp: Leo misli da će završiti domaću zadaću prije četiri (before four).

l11.exp: Bex je išla u Pariz zbog posla (to work).

l12.exp: Bex je slikala kako bi imala uspomene na Pariz (to have memories of Paris).

l13.exp: Bexine slike bile su pune života (full of life).

l14.exp: Bex se vratila kući kad je imala izložbu (when she had an exhibition).

l15.exp: Bex najljepše pamti slikanje na pariškim ulicama (painting in the Paris streets).

l16.exp: Učenici trebaju biti u parku u 10:00.

l18.exp: Nakon jela učenici mogu ići u šetnju (walking).

l20.exp: Za povratak se skupe na autobusnoj postaji (bus stop).
